In NyctoType, individual skill means typing speed. We plan a design where practice improves a player's chances of winning, while piece movement and choices among randomly offered upgrades can create opportunities to come back against a faster opponent. We aim to preserve both the value of improving and the excitement of not knowing who will win.

没入感の高いゲームプレイのための一人称視点
A first-person perspective for immersive play
本作品は、「Inscryption」「DeathJack」「Liar’s Bar」「Buckshot Roulette」といったタイトルに見られる、一人称視点でボードゲームをプレイするようなスタイルを採用します。ゲーム内のオブジェクトや演出を自身の視点で体験することで、実際にボードゲームを遊ぶような直感的でわかりやすい体験を目指します。

The game adopts a first-person board-game style seen in titles such as Inscryption, DeathJack, Liar's Bar and Buckshot Roulette. Experiencing the objects and effects directly from the player's viewpoint aims to create an intuitive, easy-to-understand experience, much like playing a physical board game.
さらに、ボード上のエフェクトや動的な演出など、物理的なボードゲームではできない表現を加え、臨場感と世界への没入感を高めます。
Board effects and dynamic presentation that are not possible in a physical board game add a sense of presence and deepen immersion in the world.
また、ボード全体を常に見渡せるため、観戦時にもどちらが優勢かを把握しやすい構図です。MOBAやFPSのように一人のプレイヤーの周囲だけを映す画角と異なり、ゲーム実況や大会の配信でも、頻繁にカメラを切り替えずに、戦況や各プレイヤーの狙いを追いやすくなります。

Keeping the whole board in view makes it easy for spectators to see who has the advantage. Unlike views in MOBAs or FPS games that show only one player's surroundings, this framing makes it easier to follow both the state of the match and what each player is trying to do during gameplay streams and tournament broadcasts, without frequent camera changes.

In NyctoType, individual skill means typing speed: practice can steadily improve a player's chances of winning.
